scope: Recovery of agents held for missing session evidence, and an explicit operator exit
changes: A recovery whose generation took authority but never reached running (held actor) no longer blocks the next --recover-stopped; previously it failed with os error 87 against the dead server process.
Held generations carry the last verified history binding forward, so evidence that becomes available again resumes the exact original session.
Stopped work owned by an agent that was not relaunched in the latest generation is fenced by the process recorded in its prompt permit.

New offline command: ccb herdr repair <agent> --fresh-session [--dry-run]. Records a durable, idempotent intent; the next recovery closes sent executions as incomplete (operator_fresh_session, never replayed), drops cached history and launches a fresh session. Intents are audited as requested/applied/superseded.
